verdict.rationale: Evidence shows multi-currency support and consolidated statements within a single entity's currencies (xero-docs-17, xero-docs-22), but no evidence of managing multiple legal entities or producing true cross-entity consolidated financials (e.g., no mention of Xero HQ, Practice Manager consolidation, or inter-entity eliminations). Missing for 10: multi-entity org management, cross-entity consolidation tooling, elimination entries, and any accountant-facing consolidated reporting across separate Xero organizations.
